statement.zh: 诸语境所显示者恰在语境相交处一致时粘合，不依语境的主张的框架恰在处处粘合时合；有的世界在任何配置都不粘合（Specker 的盒子；两量子比特的 Mermin–Peres 方阵）。部分失去整体有两种方式：不给回整体，或没有整体。
statement.en: What contexts show glues exactly where contexts agree where they meet, and a frame of context-free claims fits exactly where it glues everywhere; some worlds glue nowhere (Specker's boxes; the two-qubit Mermin–Peres square). Parts fail a whole in two ways: they do not give it back, or there is none.

claim.zh: 在语境中显示的主张（Contextual S K C V）：within k c 说主张 c 在语境 k 之内，shows s k c 是 k 在配置 s 处显示的 c 的值。在 s 处诸语境所显示者粘合（Contextual.Glues），指有 v : C → V 与每个语境在其内的每个主张上一致；它推出同一主张所在的任意两个语境一致（Contextual.Glues.agree），每个主张在某个语境之内时两者等价（Contextual.glues_iff_agree）。连同语境读，所显示的每一个是框架的主张（Contextual.indexed），以语境为索引的框架合于所显示的每一个（Contextual.indexed_fits）；不依语境的主张的框架合（Contextual.FitsFree），恰当诸语境所显示者在每个配置粘合（Contextual.fitsFree_iff）。语境能显示什么只取决于其内的主张（Local），没有不依语境的读法落在每个语境的可能性之内（NoGlobal）时，没有尊重可能性的配置粘合（Contextual.not_glues），只要一个配置尊重它们，就没有不依语境的主张的框架合（Contextual.no_free_frame）。整体 W 在语境中允许的（restrict）是局部的（restrict_local），W 在其部分粘合成者（Glued）之内（glued_of_whole）；部分给回整体记作 PartsDetermine；可能性非空且没有不依语境的读法时，它们不是任何整体的部分（no_whole）。Specker 的三个盒子与三次打开、打开的两个中恰有一个有宝石：可能性局部（Specker.local_），没有打开强制任何盒子（Specker.unforced），没有放置合于全部（Specker.noGlobal），每次打开都在第一个盒子显示宝石的世界尊重它们（Specker.respects）而不粘合（Specker.not_glues），它们不是任何整体的部分（Specker.no_whole）。Mermin–Peres 方阵：九格三行三列，每行与前两列的奇偶为偶，第三列为奇：可能性局部（Square.local_），没有线强制任何格（Square.unforced），没有赋值合于全部六条线（Square.nine、Square.noGlobal），它们不是任何整体的部分（Square.no_whole）。量子实现（Becoming.Quantum）：两个量子比特上的九个可观测量作为整数矩阵，每个平方为 I（obs_sq），每条线的三个两两对易（line_commute），线的乘积在第三列为 −I、否则为 I（line_product）；非零向量在一条线上共同显示的值有该线的奇偶（line_parity），是该线的一个可能（shows_support），每个可能都由一个明确的整数向量显示（line_realized、support_shown）；所以没有对九格的赋值在每条线上被量子态共同显示（no_context_free_values）。不用 Lean 公理（生成的单射引理 injEq 除外，没有源声明使用它们）。
claim.en: Claims shown in contexts (Contextual S K C V): within k c says that claim c lies within context k, and shows s k c is what k shows of c at configuration s. At s what the contexts show glues (Contextual.Glues) when some v : C → V agrees with every context on every claim within it; this gives that any two contexts a claim lies within agree (Contextual.Glues.agree), and where each claim lies within some context the two are equivalent (Contextual.glues_iff_agree). Read with its context, everything shown is a claim of a frame (Contextual.indexed), and the indexed frame fits everything shown (Contextual.indexed_fits); a frame of context-free claims fits (Contextual.FitsFree) exactly where what the contexts show glues at every configuration (Contextual.fitsFree_iff). Where what a context can show depends only on the claims within it (Local) and no context-free reading lies within every context's possibilities (NoGlobal), no configuration respecting the possibilities glues (Contextual.not_glues), and if one configuration respects them no frame of context-free claims fits (Contextual.no_free_frame). What a whole W allows within a context (restrict) is local (restrict_local), and W lies within what its parts glue to (Glued, glued_of_whole); the parts giving the whole back is PartsDetermine; nonempty possibilities with no context-free reading are the parts of no whole (no_whole). Specker's three boxes and three openings, exactly one of the two opened holding the gem: the possibilities are local (Specker.local_), no opening forces a box (Specker.unforced), no placement fits all (Specker.noGlobal), the world showing the gem in each opening's first box respects them (Specker.respects) and does not glue (Specker.not_glues), and they are the parts of no whole (Specker.no_whole). The Mermin–Peres square, nine cells in three rows and three columns, rows and the first two columns of even parity and the third column odd: the possibilities are local (Square.local_), no line forces a cell (Square.unforced), no assignment fits all six lines (Square.nine, Square.noGlobal), and they are the parts of no whole (Square.no_whole). The quantum realization (Becoming.Quantum): the nine two-qubit observables as integer matrices each square to I (obs_sq), the three of each line commute pairwise (line_commute), and a line multiplies to −I in the third column and to I otherwise (line_product); the values a nonzero vector shows jointly on a line have the line's parity (line_parity) and are a possibility of the line (shows_support), and every possibility is shown by an explicit integer vector (line_realized, support_shown); so no assignment to the nine cells is shown jointly on every line by quantum states (no_context_free_values). No Lean axiom is used (except by the generated injectivity lemmas injEq, which no source declaration uses).

hypotheses.zh: 不加前提：glues_iff_agree 与 fitsFree_iff 是双向的，要每个主张在一个语境之内（home、covers）。
hypotheses.en: No premise: glues_iff_agree and fitsFree_iff are two-way and need a context each claim lies within (home, covers).

hypotheses.zh: not_glues 与 no_free_frame 要可能性局部、没有不依语境的读法与一个尊重它们的配置；no_whole 要某个语境允许某物，不用局部性（局部条件）。
hypotheses.en: not_glues and no_free_frame need local possibilities, no context-free reading and one configuration respecting them; no_whole needs some context to allow something, and does not use locality (local conditions).

hypotheses.zh: 量子实现只覆盖这个方阵：实矩阵、整数本征向量；希尔伯特空间、测量与 Born 权重没有陈述。
hypotheses.en: The quantum realization covers only this square: real matrices and integer eigenvectors; Hilbert space, measurement and Born weights are not stated.

correspondence.zh: P72 与 P72q（工作板），按 Ren 2026-10-12 的“push the frontier, as far as possible”，回答 Ren 的“wave/particle”：核心的 Frame 在类型上把主张读作不依语境，这里把它定为表示的承诺并给出它何时合的充要条件；量子测量所显示者属于不粘合的一类（两个量子比特上的 Kochen–Specker，Mermin 1990、Peres 1990）。P72q 由“Cause–effect system theory comparison”（P64–P68 的所有者）写成并检查。部分失去整体的两种方式（不给回：P70 的奇偶；没有整体：no_whole）是可能性上层的唯一与粘合两个条件。读法（AI 的，依 Ren 的交托采用；Ren 同意了包含它们的回答）：波与粒子都是向不依语境的值的投影；值是在语境中显示者，即关系；Ren 推测的“真”是关系的。见整合文档 §96。
correspondence.en: P72 and P72q (work board), following Ren's “push the frontier, as far as possible” of 12 October 2026, answering Ren's “wave/particle”: the core's Frame reads claims as context-free by type; here that is named a commitment of the representation, with the condition under which it fits; what quantum measurements show is of the kind that does not glue (Kochen–Specker for two qubits, Mermin 1990, Peres 1990). P72q was written and checked by “Cause–effect system theory comparison” (the owner of P64–P68). The two ways parts fail a whole (not giving it back: P70's parity; having no whole: no_whole) are the uniqueness and gluing conditions of a sheaf, for possibilities. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation; Ren agreed with the reply containing them): wave and particle are both projections onto context-free values; a value is what a context shows, a relation; the truth of Ren's speculation is relational. See §96 of the integration note.

detail.zh: 部分失去整体的另一种方式：奇偶是诸对不给回的整体，在同样的三对上。
detail.en: The other way parts fail a whole: parity is a whole its pairs do not give back, on the same three pairs.

detail.zh: 另一种投影的限制：从内部持有每个读法。
detail.en: Another limit of projection: holding every reading from within.

detail.zh: 语境中所显示者总是一个世界的关系项，不用粘合；World 的平衡是所立与交换两种变化读法的粘合。Ren 批准语境中的读法为一般情形。
detail.en: What contexts show is always the relata of one world, with no gluing; World's balance is the gluing of the standing's and the exchange's readings of change. Ren approved the readings in context as the general case.

detail.zh: 回答其下一步“奇偶障碍的一般定理”：不依语境的读法恰在没有一组语境矛盾处粘合，矛盾时不依语境之赋值的混合平均至多满足 m 个语境中的 m − 1 个。
detail.en: Answers its next step “the general parity obstruction”: context-free readings glue exactly where no selection of contexts contradicts, and where one does a mixture of context-free assignments meets on average at most m − 1 of its m contexts.

detail.zh: Specker 的三个盒子与 Mermin–Peres 方阵：每个语境内一致，没有语境强制任何主张，没有不依语境的读法（Specker.noGlobal、Square.noGlobal）；量子比特实现方阵（Becoming.Quantum 的 no_context_free_values）。
detail.en: Specker's three boxes and the Mermin–Peres square: consistent within each context, no context forcing a claim, no context-free reading (Specker.noGlobal, Square.noGlobal); qubits realize the square (no_context_free_values of Becoming.Quantum).

limitations.zh: 只陈述可能性，不陈述概率（Bell 型不等式）；一般的层论与 Abramsky–Brandenburger 框架没有陈述；奇偶障碍的一般定理没有陈述，三个见证各自由 decide 检查；量子实现只覆盖这个方阵；PartsDetermine 要求一个值的类型；读法是 AI 的；不含伦理谓词。
limitations.en: Only possibilities are stated, not probabilities (Bell-type inequalities); general sheaf theory and the Abramsky–Brandenburger framework are not stated; the general parity obstruction is not stated, the three witnesses each checked by decide; the quantum realization covers only this square; PartsDetermine needs one type of values; the readings are the AI's; contains no ethical predicate.
